mapper.select: SELECT user_v.user_id, ou.aid, ou.pkg, ou.gaid, ou.dates, ou.create_time register_time, ou.last_login_dates, ou.last_login last_login_time, user_v.version, user_v.min_version, IFNULL(ouh.address, 'IN') country FROM ods_user ou left join (SELECT user_id, max(pvn) `version`, min(pvn) min_version FROM ods_user_version ouv WHERE ouv.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY user_id) user_v ON (ou.id = user_v.user_id) LEFT JOIN ods_user_hema ouh ON (ou.aid = ouh.aid and ouh.pkg = ou.pkg) where ou.id = #{userId}
SELECT id, user_id, aid, pkg, country, version, gaid, dates, register_time, last_version, last_login_dates, last_login_time, create_time, update_time FROM dim_user_info WHERE user_id = #{userId}
